items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: we had Clark Smith and the Chicago Defender... hired Basie and Clark Smith to start a youth band, and that’s where we came in... Oh, the man was my master.

ctx.x: Ray Nance, Lionel Hampton. You know what was so wonderful about that it was a black community, and we didn’t all go to the same school, but we all met musically. So with bands, like, you went to some school, I went to Winifred, but we had rehearsals, and then after hours, we met, and that’s how we got to know each other. And to see all of that going on, we had Clark Smith and the Chicago Defender, the newspaper, hired Basie and Clark Smith to start a youth band, and that’s where we came in. My mother was Nat…
